In the LDAP Users tab of the LDAP Configuration window, view options in the Default LDAP User Group drop down box.
1825350.title: LDAP Configuration> LDAP Users. Default LDAP User Group. Select
1825350.result: The Default LDAP User Group drop down box displays the following items: 'None', 'Create a new users group...', 'Content Filtering Bypass', 'Everyone', 'Guest Services', 'Limited Administrators', and 'Trusted Users'.
